title: Make Kani's proofs build and keep CI caches inside the 10 GB quota
goal: The second completed main run (37434078991) showed warm shards at 1.2-3.3 min and post-merge acceptance passing, and three remaining problems: (1) Kani's harnesses never compiled (PolicyClass lacked kani::Arbitrary; all 3 proofs verify once it does); (2) the torn-record regression test counted other tests' records in the process-global journal; (3) ~16 GB of cache demand against GitHub's 10 GB limit, so LRU eviction cold-starts ~40% of jobs each run (e2e went 3.4 -> 13.8 min).
